remarks: Single-level living just minutes from Westlake Lake. This recently remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,724 sq. ft. at an exceptional value for one of Westlake Village's most sought-after neighborhoods. The brand-new kitchen has quartz countertops, a fresh backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. Luxury vinyl plank flooring runs throughout, along with dual-pane windows and classic white wood shutters. In the living room, vaulted ceilings with natural wood exposed beams set a warm tone, and the fireplace has matching wood detail. The zero-lot-line design keeps maintenance easy, leaving more time to enjoy the community pool, tennis court, and clubhouse. You're moments from The Landing
